_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil regime (5% of windows move ±2+) makes HOLD the statistically honest default, and neither the stablecoin growth nor ETF flow breakers required to confirm a directional resolution are currently visible.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies a bullish lean toward mean reversion but does not commit to a directional call, creating an implicit disagreement on forward direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth reverses above 45 AND etf_flows resume above 25 within next 2-3 windows
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with btc_momentum_30d rolling over below 40, pushing toward Panic/Capitulation
